technique_name: Write a short story involving the two given objects
description: Once upon a time, a little girl dreamed of traveling to the moon. But no matter how much she wished, she could never find a way to make her dreams come true. One night, however, a magical pencil dropped from the sky and landed in her lap. She grabbed the pencil and began to draw the most incredible and wonderful picture she could imagine - a rocket soaring through the sky, straight up to the moon.
